using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Xunit;
using Moq;
using OpenRA.Support;
using OpenRA.Mods.Common;
using System.Net.Http;
using OpenRA;

namespace OpenRA.Mods.Common.Tests
{
    public class WebServicesTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void CheckModVersion_SetsDefaultStatus_WhenNotCalled()
        {
            var webServices = new WebServices();
            Assert.Equal(ModVersionStatus.NotChecked, webServices.ModVersionStatus);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task CheckModVersion_CallsHttpClientWithCorrectUrl()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockClient = new Mock<HttpClient>();
            var mockFactory = new Mock<HttpClientFactory>();
            mockFactory.Setup(f => f.Create()).Returns(mockClient.Object);

            // Replace static HttpClientFactory.Create with our mock (for test isolation)
            var originalCreate = HttpClientFactory.Create;
            HttpClientFactory.Create = () => mockClient.Object;

            var mockGame = new Mock<IGame>();
            mockGame.Setup(g => g.EngineVersion).Returns("test-engine");
            mockGame.Setup(g => g.ModData.Manifest.Id).Returns("test-mod");
            mockGame.Setup(g => g.ModData.Manifest.Metadata.Version).Returns("1.0");
            mockGame.Setup(g => g.RunAfterTick(It.IsAny<Action>()));

            // Mock Game static
            var gameField = typeof(Game).GetField("engineVersion", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Static | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic);
            gameField?.SetValue(null, "test-engine");

            var webServices = new WebServices();

            // Act
            webServices.CheckModVersion();
            await Task.Delay(100); // Allow async task to run

            // Assert
            mockClient.Verify(c => c.GetAsync(It.Is<string>(url =>
                url.Contains("protocol=1") &&
                url.Contains("engine=test-engine") &&
                url.Contains("mod=test-mod") &&
                url.Contains("version=1.0"))), Times.Once);

            // Cleanup
            HttpClientFactory.Create = originalCreate;
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task CheckModVersion_SetsLatestStatus_OnLatestResponse()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockClient = new Mock<HttpClient>();
            var response = new HttpResponseMessage();
            response.Content = new StringContent("latest");
            mockClient.Setup(c => c.GetAsync(It.IsAny<string>())).ReturnsAsync(response);
            
            HttpClientFactory.Create = () => mockClient.Object;

            var mockGame = new Mock<IGame>();
            mockGame.Setup(g => g.EngineVersion).Returns("test");
            mockGame.Setup(g => g.ModData.Manifest.Id).Returns("test");
            mockGame.Setup(g => g.ModData.Manifest.Metadata.Version).Returns("1.0");
            mockGame.Setup(g => g.RunAfterTick(It.IsAny<Action>()));

            var webServices = new WebServices();

            // Act
            webServices.CheckModVersion();
            await Task.Delay(100);

            // Assert - status should be Latest (default) since "latest" case doesn't change it
            Assert.Equal(ModVersionStatus.Latest, webServices.ModVersionStatus);

            HttpClientFactory.Create = () => new HttpClient();
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task CheckModVersion_SetsOutdatedStatus_OnOutdatedResponse()
        {
            await TestStatusResponse("outdated", ModVersionStatus.Outdated);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task CheckModVersion_SetsUnknownStatus_OnUnknownResponse()
        {
            await TestStatusResponse("unknown", ModVersionStatus.Unknown);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task CheckModVersion_SetsPlaytestAvailableStatus_OnPlaytestResponse()
        {
            await TestStatusResponse("playtest", ModVersionStatus.PlaytestAvailable);
        }

        private async Task TestStatusResponse(string responseText, ModVersionStatus expectedStatus)
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockClient = new Mock<HttpClient>();
            var httpResponse = new HttpResponseMessage();
            httpResponse.Content = new StringContent(responseText);
            mockClient.Setup(c => c.GetAsync(It.IsAny<string>())).ReturnsAsync(httpResponse);
            
            HttpClientFactory.Create = () => mockClient.Object;

            var mockGame = new Mock<IGame>();
            mockGame.Setup(g => g.EngineVersion).Returns("test");
            mockGame.Setup(g => g.ModData.Manifest.Id).Returns("test");
            mockGame.Setup(g => g.ModData.Manifest.Metadata.Version).Returns("1.0");
            mockGame.Setup(g => g.RunAfterTick(It.IsAny<Action>()));

            var webServices = new WebServices();

            // Act
            webServices.CheckModVersion();
            await Task.Delay(100);

            // Assert
            Assert.Equal(expectedStatus, webServices.ModVersionStatus);

            HttpClientFactory.Create = () => new HttpClient();
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task CheckModVersion_HandlesExceptionGracefully()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockClient = new Mock<HttpClient>();
            mockClient.Setup(c => c.GetAsync(It.IsAny<string>())).ThrowsAsync(new HttpRequestException());
            
            HttpClientFactory.Create = () => mockClient.Object;

            var mockGame = new Mock<IGame>();
            mockGame.Setup(g => g.EngineVersion).Returns("test");
            mockGame.Setup(g => g.ModData.Manifest.Id).Returns("test");
            mockGame.Setup(g => g.ModData.Manifest.Metadata.Version).Returns("1.0");
            mockGame.Setup(g => g.RunAfterTick(It.IsAny<Action>()));

            var webServices = new WebServices();

            // Act
            webServices.CheckModVersion();
            await Task.Delay(100);

            // Assert - should not crash, status remains default
            Assert.Equal(ModVersionStatus.NotChecked, webServices.ModVersionStatus);

            HttpClientFactory.Create = () => new HttpClient();
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Xunit;
using OpenRA.Mods.Common;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Text;
using Moq;
using System.Reflection;

namespace OpenRA.Mods.Common.Tests
{
    public class WebServicesTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void ModVersionStatus_DefaultsToNotChecked()
        {
            // Arrange & Act
            var webServices = new WebServices();

            // Assert
            Assert.Equal(ModVersionStatus.NotChecked, webServices.ModVersionStatus);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task CheckModVersion_SetsLatestStatus_OnEmptyOrUnknownResponse()
        {
            await TestStatusResponse("", ModVersionStatus.Latest);
            await TestStatusResponse("latest", ModVersionStatus.Latest);
            await TestStatusResponse("something-else", ModVersionStatus.Latest);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task CheckModVersion_SetsOutdatedStatus_OnOutdatedResponse()
        {
            await TestStatusResponse("outdated", ModVersionStatus.Outdated);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task CheckModVersion_SetsUnknownStatus_OnUnknownResponse()
        {
            await TestStatusResponse("unknown", ModVersionStatus.Unknown);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task CheckModVersion_SetsPlaytestAvailableStatus_OnPlaytestResponse()
        {
            await TestStatusResponse("playtest", ModVersionStatus.PlaytestAvailable);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task CheckModVersion_DoesNotChangeStatus_OnException()
        {
            // Arrange
            var webServices = new WebServices();
            webServices.ModVersionStatus = ModVersionStatus.Latest; // pre-set to verify it doesn't change

            var mockHttpClientFactory = new Mock<HttpClientFactory>();
            mockHttpClientFactory.Setup(f => f.Create()).Returns((HttpClient)null); // will throw

            // Replace HttpClientFactory.Create with throwing version
            var createMethod = typeof(HttpClientFactory).GetMethod("Create", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public);
            var originalDelegate = (Func<HttpClient>)Delegate.CreateDelegate(typeof(Func<HttpClient>), createMethod);
            
            try
            {
                HttpClientFactory.Create = () => { throw new InvalidOperationException("Simulated failure"); };

                // Act
                webServices.CheckModVersion();
                await Task.Delay(200); // Give async task time to complete

                // Assert - status unchanged due to exception handling
                Assert.Equal(ModVersionStatus.Latest, webServices.ModVersionStatus);
            }
            finally
            {
                // Cleanup - restore original
                HttpClientFactory.Create = originalDelegate;
            }
        }

        private async Task TestStatusResponse(string responseText, ModVersionStatus expectedStatus)
        {
            // Arrange
            var webServices = new WebServices();
            
            var mockClient = new Mock<HttpClient>();
            var mockResponse = new HttpResponseMessage(System.Net.HttpStatusCode.OK);
            mockResponse.Content = new StringContent(responseText);
            mockClient.Setup(c => c.GetAsync(It.IsAny<string>())).ReturnsAsync(mockResponse);

            // Mock Game static properties using reflection
            MockStaticGameProperties("test-engine", "test-mod", "1.0");

            try
            {
                // Replace HttpClientFactory.Create
                HttpClientFactory.Create = () => mockClient.Object;

                // Act
                webServices.CheckModVersion();
                await Task.Delay(200); // Allow Task.Run to complete

                // Assert
                Assert.Equal(expectedStatus, webServices.ModVersionStatus);
            }
            finally
            {
                // Cleanup
                HttpClientFactory.Create = HttpClientFactory.Create; // reset to original
                ResetStaticGameProperties();
            }
        }

        private void MockStaticGameProperties(string engineVersion, string modId, string modVersion)
        {
            // Mock Game static properties via reflection
            var gameType = Type.GetType("OpenRA.Game, OpenRA");
            if (gameType != null)
            {
                var engineVersionField = gameType.GetField("EngineVersion", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
                engineVersionField?.SetValue(null, engineVersion);

                // Mock ModData properties (simplified - just enough for URL building)
                // Note: Full mocking would require more complex setup, but URL correctness isn't asserted here
            }
        }

        private void ResetStaticGameProperties()
        {
            var gameType = Type.GetType("OpenRA.Game, OpenRA");
            if (gameType != null)
            {
                var engineVersionField = gameType.GetField("EngineVersion", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
                engineVersionField?.SetValue(null, null);
            }
        }
    }
}
